riskDescription: Finance users are receiving targeted spoofed emails; risk of O365 account takeover and lateral movement.
riskExplanation: Legacy secure email gateway lacks DMARC enforcement and advanced phishing detection.

riskDescription: Core file shares could be encrypted causing multi-day outage and data loss.
riskExplanation: Patch cadence and network segmentation are insufficient; RDP open to internet on two hosts.

riskDescription: Customer export files may be publicly accessible due to bucket ACL misconfig.
riskExplanation: No automated policy checks; missing bucket policy to block public access.

riskDescription: Production checkout fails if payment gateway is down; revenue loss and SLA penalties.
riskExplanation: No active-active failover; fallback gateway not integrated or tested.

riskDescription: Attacker could dump customer DB via vulnerable search endpoint.
riskExplanation: Missing server-side validation; ORM queries build from raw input; weak WAF rules.
